family.rule: No secondary or display face is used. Hierarchy is expressed through weight, size, tracking, and spacing alone.

display.purpose: Page titles and major section headers

caption.purpose: Footnoted data, non-interactive metadata, legibility floor

rules: Single-family: Inter throughout. No secondary or display face.
Hierarchy is expressed through weight, size, tracking, and spacing — never through font changes.
Interactive text below 11px (text-caption) is prohibited. Caption is the legibility floor for non-interactive metadata only.
Monospace is reserved for tabular data, code, and alphanumeric identifiers. Never for body text.
Display uses tight negative letter-spacing (-0.01em) to reduce rivers at large sizes.
Label uses explicit positive tracking (0.025em) to aid readability at small sizes, especially when uppercased.
Tabular figures (tnum) are a future enhancement for data tables.

narrative.overview: AssignmentHub's visual language is inspired by modern digital banking — clean, professional, and welcoming. Every surface communicates trust through restraint: generous whitespace, a single blue accent (Tech Blue #2563EB), and warm neutral tones that soften the digital edge. The blue is the product's voice — present in every primary action, link, and active indicator. It signals confidence without aggression. Cards float on soft shadows over a subtly warm canvas, creating depth without visual noise. The palette is intentionally restrained: warm neutrals for all surfaces, Tech Blue as the sole accent for actions and navigation, and a warm red reserved exclusively for destructive actions. Every corner is generously rounded (26px maximum), keeping the feel approachable while maintaining a professional edge.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral background (oklch(0.985 0.003 65)) — inviting, not clinical
Tech Blue (#2563EB) as the single committed accent — purposeful, confident
Generous rounded corners (26px max) keep the feel approachable
Soft shadows provide card elevation without drama
Clean, restrained — the interface recedes so the data leads

rules.name: The Blue-Accent Rule
rules.body: Tech Blue is the only chromatic accent. Primary actions, links, active navigation, and focus indicators use it. Chromatic color outside of Tech Blue and Ember (destructive) is decoration and violates the system's contract.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter is used throughout. No secondary font family. Hierarchy is expressed through weight, size, and spacing alone.

rules.name: The Soft-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit at rest with a soft shadow. Shadows darken only at modal elevation. Hover states use background tint (hover:bg-muted), not shadow changes.

dos: Do use Tech Blue for primary actions, links, and active indicators
Do keep the palette warm-neutral; the blue accent carries the brand
Do use shadow-md + ring-1 ring-border on cards
Do use the full 26px radius on cards, dialogs, and buttons
Do use hover:bg-muted or hover:bg-secondary for interactive feedback
donts: Don't add chromatic color beyond Tech Blue and Ember (destructive)
Don't use decorative color — the blue accent earns its place through purpose
Don't use shadow-lg or shadow-2xl — only shadow-md and shadow-xl
Don't mix neutral temperatures — keep the warm tint consistent
Don't place text larger than 14px (text-sm) in body content without a hierarchy reason
Don't add font families beyond Inter
